data.excerpt: ## Scripted Localization There is a special localization command that allows a scripted GUI element to display its effect within a tooltip.
data.text: ## Scripted Localization There is a special localization command that allows a scripted GUI element to display its effect within a tooltip. `[!_]` For example: `MY_TOOLTIP: "[!test_button_click]"` A similar command is available for the triggers for that particular element. `[!__enabled]` For example: `MY_TOOLTIP: "[!test_button_click_enabled]"`
